topic: 近一年 Ego-centric 数据手部检测与追踪的问题和难点

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): The static embodied-AI taxonomy under-specifies egocentric hand detection, hand mesh recovery, temporal identity tracking, and hand-object occlusion.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-hand-detection
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND (all:"hand detection" OR all:"hand segmentation")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Directly retrieves first-person hand localization and segmentation work.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-hand-pose
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND (all:"3D hand pose" OR all:"hand pose estimation" OR all:"hand mesh")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Covers joint and mesh estimation, which are the dominant technical meanings of hand tracking in recent work.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-first-person-hand-tracking
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"first-person" OR all:egocentric) AND all:hand AND (all:tracking OR all:temporal)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Finds explicit temporal tracking and sequence-consistency work.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-hand-object
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND (all:"hand-object interaction" OR all:"hand object") AND (all:pose OR all:tracking OR all:detection)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Interaction is the main source of self/object occlusion and contact ambiguity.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-hand-occlusion-motion-blur
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND all:hand AND (all:occlusion OR all:"motion blur" OR all:truncation OR all:"ego-motion")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Targets the dominant failure conditions rather than only successful methods.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-bimanual-identity
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND (all:bimanual OR all:"two hands") AND (all:tracking OR all:pose OR all:identity)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Bimanual overlap and left/right identity swaps are a distinct tracking failure mode.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-hand-tracking-benchmark
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND all:hand AND (all:benchmark OR all:dataset OR all:evaluation) AND (all:pose OR all:tracking)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Retrieves datasets and evaluation protocols needed to audit annotation and metric gaps.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-ego-exo-hand-ground-truth
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"ego-exo" OR all:multiview) AND all:hand AND (all:"ground truth" OR all:annotation OR all:tracking)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Multi-view capture is the main route to accurate in-the-wild 3D hand ground truth.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-event-camera-hand-pose
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND all:hand AND (all:event OR all:stereo) AND (all:pose OR all:tracking)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Event/stereo sensing directly addresses blur, dynamic range, and depth ambiguity.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-realtime-hoi-industrial
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND all:hand AND (all:"real-time" OR all:streaming OR all:industrial) AND (all:detection OR all:tracking OR all:interaction)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Surfaces latency, compute, and cascade-error trade-offs in deployable systems.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-browser-egocentric-hand-2025
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org egocentric hand pose tracking occlusion 2025 2026
dynamic_suggestions.why: Fallback for current papers poorly indexed by the arXiv API.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-web-egocentric-hand
dynamic_suggestions.why: Discover current dataset and method names.

calibration_notes: arxiv-search calibration (high): Recent terminology includes stereo event streams, KeypointBEV, bimanual occlusion, and ego-motion interference.
arxiv-search calibration (high): Recent data terminology includes ego-exo 3D hand tracking, mobile multi-camera rig, in-the-wild, and marker-less ground truth.
arxiv-search calibration (high): Deployment terminology includes streaming egocentric vision, active object detection, cascaded architecture, and real-time industrial domains.
